0022600183.text: The Trail Blazers (5-1, winners of their last two, 4-0 on the road) visit the Phoenix Suns (1-4, on a three-game losing streak) in Portland's seventh game of the season, with Portland 1st in the Northwest and 3rd in the West while Phoenix sits 12th in the West. Portland is missing Ja Morant (hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), while Phoenix is without Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery) and has Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Rasheer Fleming (ankle sprain) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. Portland leads the season series 1-0 after a 124-83 win in Portland on October 21, though the Trail Blazers lost 1-2 to Phoenix in 2025-26.
